schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE materie (
    id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    codice_materia TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    denominazione TEXT NOT NULL,
    cfu INT NOT NULL CHECK (cfu BETWEEN 1 AND 36),
    semestre INT NOT NULL CHECK (semestre IN (1, 2)),
    prerequisito_id INT REFERENCES materie(id),
    creato_il TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE esami_sostenuti (
    id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    matricola_studente TEXT NOT NULL,
    cognome_studente TEXT NOT NULL,
    nome_studente TEXT NOT NULL,
    materia_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES materie(id),
    data_esame DATE NOT NULL,
    voto NUMERIC(4,1) CHECK (voto BETWEEN 18 AND 30),
    lode BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    UNIQUE (matricola_studente, materia_id, data_esame)
);
